name: quality-gate
description: Reusable: delta-scoped lint + full unit tests before commit (gate-agent pattern from SAM6). On failure the step just stops the execution -- compose this into a Ralph-driven pipeline so a failure here is picked up by Ralph's own iteration retry, rather than looping internally (a LOOP compensation can only target a step declared in this same definition, not a parent's 'implement' step). Adjust the lint command/base branch to the project's actual toolchain before use.
